SELECT n.id AS id, n.title AS title, n.username AS username, n.create_time AS createTime, COUNT(l.id) AS likeCount FROM notes n LEFT JOIN likes l ON l.note_id = n.id WHERE n.is_public = 1 AND n.audit_status = 2 GROUP BY n.id ORDER BY likeCount DESC, n.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT n.username AS username, COUNT(l.id) AS totalLikes FROM notes n INNER JOIN likes l ON l.note_id = n.id WHERE n.is_public = 1 AND n.audit_status = 2 GROUP BY n.username ORDER BY totalLikes DESC LIMIT #{limit}
